grecoil89 external provider test log
====================================

Version: 1.1.0
Language mode: C89 (-std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic)
Memory model: caller-owned, no allocation
Numeric model: fixed-point Q8.8 only

Builds passed:
- demo_grecoil89
- demo_bridge
- demo_provider
- grecoil89_curve_dump

Provider behavior passed:
- PUSH mode calls external rotate and move adapters.
- PULL mode caches output without invoking adapters.
- Pull accessors return aim/camera/weapon rotation and weapon move.
- Channel mask prevents disabled channels from being returned or pushed.
- clear() publishes a zero additive transform layer.
- OFF mode rejects updates.

Integration rule:
External systems must SET/replace the recoil additive layer each tick. They
must not accumulate the returned transform onto the previous recoil result.
